decision_reason: The browser reproduces the must-requirement failure and the existing release application SQL visibly omits subsystem_code while the candidate contract declares it searchable.

causal_assessment.hypothesis: ReleaseApplicationStore.findPage omits subsystem_code from the existing keyword predicate.
supporting_evidence: Exact application code SQ-202608-002 returns a candidate, proving the frontend remote event path works.
AUTH returns no candidate although the visible application row has subsystem code AUTH.
The SQL predicate contains application_code LIKE and subsystem_name LIKE only.
causal_assessment.falsifier: AUTH still returns no candidate after subsystem_code is included and the backend is restarted.

invariants: Tenant, project, status, mine-only, sorting and pagination predicates remain unchanged.
No API route, DTO, database schema or dependency changes.
control_action.impact_limit: One additional OR predicate and one persistence contract assertion in the business/release module.
control_action.rollback: Remove the subsystem_code predicate and its focused contract test.
correction_check: Repeat AUTH candidate search and verify the main table remains unchanged before selection.
Rerun the frontend production build and whitespace check.

residual_risk: Case-insensitive behavior still depends on the existing MySQL collation, as did the original keyword fields.
